release_notes:
1. Accurate Previous Status Resolution: Seamlessly extracts previous order state from oldOrderStatus parameter and historical order database log, eliminating previous_status_id: 0.
2. Ironclad Refund & Cancel Classification: Order status updates to Refunded (ID 7, 20, 26) or Canceled (ID 6) always classify with transitionType: refund_issued / order_canceled and conversion_action: retract.
3. Complete compatibility with GA4 offline purchase retraction, Google Ads offline adjustments, and Meta CAPI reversal workflows.
